plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: Provides a standardized Specification-Driven Development (SDD) methodology that ensures consistent, high-quality software development practices when working with Claude Code.

plugins.name: pace
plugins.description: Context management for Claude Code as a personal agent on non-coding tasks: compact in-progress work to disk and resume it in a fresh session.

plugins.name: agent-engineering
plugins.description: Cross-cutting skills for disciplined AI-assisted development based on the 10 Claude Code Principles (Forsythe). Includes agent-prompt diagnosis, four-section restatement of end-of-work reports (done / pending / blocking / next), cross-cutting architectural decision capture, codebase architecture surveys (deep-module candidates), development-cycle retrospectives, a simplicity challenge that cuts a proposal down to tiers before it is built, OWASP AI-agent security review (standalone + wired into the SDD flow), git-worktree support for BB IDE (repo provisioning setup + merge-back handoff), and self-contained SDD flow orchestration (no SDD plugin required) with a human design gate and tiered delivery.
